201:t_106:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Make the most of the situation we've been given...! There's no time left for Earth or for humanity!」

201:t_107:0.en:
$$シャア$$
「I've been moving in case the worst happened, but is the situation worse than I estimated...」

201:t_107:1.en:
$$シャア$$
「But I can't let them end here, of all places...! Not even if it costs me my life!」

201:t_108:1.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
(Wait for me... I will definitely save you...!)

201:t_109:0.en:
$$ガロード$$
「$$ティファ$$ has been scared the whole time, even before this operation...!」

201:t_109:1.en:
$$ガロード$$
「I don't care what it is! Anyone who scares $$ティファ$$, I'll take on every last one of them myself!」

201:t_110:0.en:
$$ロラン$$
「What you people have done is destroy the lives of those living in peace!」

201:t_110:1.en:
$$ロラン$$
「I won't accept you people! I'll make you leave Earth!」

201:t_111:0.en:
$$シン$$
「I'll stop... the war... And to do that...!」

201:t_111:1.en:
$$シン$$
「We strike the heart of the Empire here! There are other enemies we have to fight!」

201:t_112:0.en:
$$キラ$$
「If we don't stop the Empire here, the fighting will spread even further...!」

201:t_112:1.en:
$$キラ$$
「I'll do it...! I'm fighting with that resolve, too!」

201:t_113:0.en:
$$刹那$$
(Why can't we understand each other... Can't dialogue stop the fighting...)

201:t_113:1.en:
$$刹那$$
(If so, then I... the $$イノベイター$$ that $$イオリア・シュヘンベルグ$$ dreamed of...)

201:t_114:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
(War takes people's lives... their possibilities...)

201:t_114:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
($$オードリー$$... If fighting can protect someone's possibilities... their future, then I'll do it...!)

201:t_115:0.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「If you people attack without a word of discussion, you're no different from $$宇宙怪獣$$!」

201:t_115:1.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Get ready! I'm... angry, you know!」

201:t_116:0.en:
$$ラルク$$
「You're a pain! Building something like this on Earth!」

201:t_116:1.en:
$$ラルク$$
「$$ディスヌフ$$! We're kicking out the ones who don't understand this planet's worth, right now!」

201:t_117:0.en:
$$ノノ$$
「I'll do it! $$ノノ$$ will give it everything she's got, too! Because...!」

201:t_117:1.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Taking down evil is the job of a champion of justice! In other words, it's the work of $$ノノリリ$$... and of $$ノノ$$!」

201:t_118:0.en:
$$バサラ$$
「This is garbage! Robbery, invasion, kidnapping, war, all of it!」

201:t_118:1.en:
$$バサラ$$
「If you've got time for that, listen to my song! Set your hearts on fire, you guys!」

201:t_119:0.en:
$$アルト$$
($$シェリル$$, $$ランカ$$... Wait for me.)

201:t_119:1.en:
$$アルト$$
(I'm fighting to win back a world where you two can sing freely...!)

201:t_120:1.en:
$$竜馬$$
(Who is it...? This overwhelming aura... Whoever it is, they're no pushover...!)

201:t_121:0.en:
$$甲児$$
「Get out of the way! Anyone who gets in our way to the Imperial Palace, I'll knock down every last one of them!」

201:t_121:1.en:
$$甲児$$
「We're fired up today! Don't think you can stop us with some little trick!」

201:t_122:0.en:
$$赤木$$
「I heard this was the decisive battle, but to join in the middle of a sudden, huge crisis...!」

201:t_122:1.en:
$$いぶき$$
「But we have no choice but to do it!」

201:t_122:2.en:
$$青山$$
「If today isn't where the fighting ends, we have to carry it on into tomorrow!」

201:t_122:3.en:
$$赤木$$
「Let's go, $$いぶき$$, $$青山$$! We're getting everyone out of here no matter what!」

201:t_122:4.en:
$$赤木$$
「Even a salaryman fights to win back peace!」

201:t_123:0.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Malice and violence... Don't think you can rule people with things like that...!」

201:t_123:1.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Those with hearts will keep resisting...! And we will stand at the head of them and fight you!」

201:t_123:2.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I have no intention of accepting thugs who don't understand words as negotiating partners!」

201:t_124:0.en:
$$宗介$$
($$千鳥$$... I'm fighting to see you once more...)

201:t_124:1.en:
$$宗介$$
(I will come back alive...! That is my promise to you...!)

201:t_125:0.en:
$$アマタ$$
「I'll do it...! If we just defeat the Emperor who's here, the fighting won't spread any further!」

201:t_125:1.en:
$$アマタ$$
「That's what we came here for! I'll definitely do it!」

201:t_126:0.en:
$$葵$$
「It looks like this is no time to be happy about being called in as a pinch hitter out of nowhere.」

201:t_126:1.en:
$$くらら$$
「If we let our guard down even a little this time, it's truly dangerous.」

201:t_126:2.en:
$$朔哉$$
「Tch...! Even I have no room to enjoy the thrill this time!」

201:t_126:3.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「But we must escape from this predicament no matter what...!」

201:t_126:4.en:
$$エイーダ$$
「To carry hope on into tomorrow, too...!」

201:t_126:5.en:
$$葵$$
「Let's go, everyone! We have to do it for the seniors who aren't here, too!」

201:t_126:6.en:
$$葵$$
「I'm serious this time! Let's do this!!」

201:t_127:0.en:
$$シモン$$
「I'll punch through! No matter what tries to block our path!」

201:t_127:1.en:
$$シモン$$
「And then it's a straight line to the Imperial Palace! I'll settle this with my drill!」

201:t_128:0.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(What is this sense of wrongness... Have I made a terrible mistake...)

201:t_128:1.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(No... if the enemy has set a trap, then challenging them head-on is the proper way to handle any situation! We have no choice but to keep advancing!)

201:t_129:0.en:
$$レド$$
「$$チェインバー#pilot$$, report friendly and enemy strength as it changes.」

201:t_129:1.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Understood. Depending on circumstances, I will recommend a retreat.」

201:t_129:2.en:
$$レド$$
「Don't think about falling back now! Concentrate only on moving forward!」

201:t_130:0.en:
$n
(I have to do it...! For everyone who helped me... and above all, for myself...!)

201:t_130:2.en:
$$スズネ$$
(His heart is swinging between hope and despair... There's nothing more I can do...)

201:t_131:0.en:
$$セツコ$$
(Sorrow is spreading... from that Imperial Palace out to the world...)

201:t_131:1.en:
$$セツコ$$
(I'll end it here no matter what...! Whatever we're up against!)

201:t_132:2.en:
$$ランド$$
「Of course! ...is what I'd like to say, but this time I might be in real trouble...」

201:t_132:3.en:
$$ランド$$
(This prickling sensation... Looks like we've stepped somewhere way more dangerous than we imagined.)

イオリア・シュヘンベルグ.evidence: https://gundam.fandom.com/wiki/Aeolia_Schenberg ; sheet only has イオリア (Aeolia, keyword)

kept_omissions: 201:t_120:1: unknown watcher kept gender-neutral ('they') and unnamed
201:t_107:1: 彼等 rendered 'them' (Char's referent, presumably the allied forces, left unspecified)
201:t_126:4: Eida's line kept elliptical ('To carry hope on into tomorrow, too...!'); subject unstated in Japanese, continues Johnny's 'we'
uncertain: 201:t_126:5: ここにいないセンパイ達 rendered 'the seniors who aren't here' (センパイ used as a common noun, not dropped as an honorific)
201:t_113:1: $$イオリア・シュヘンベルグ$$ proposed as a new name token (Aeolia Schenberg); sheet only has イオリア
201:t_122:2: 明日へつなげる rendered 'carry it on into tomorrow' (meaning: survive to keep fighting)
201:t_129:0: チェインバー token in speech uses #pilot form like the speaker line
201:t_116:1: ディスヌフ taken as Lal'C calling her machine by name (token robot form)
201:t_132:2: Rand's 'Of course! ...is what I'd like to say' reads slightly stiff; intent is 'I'd like to say so, but'
201:t_122:3: Akagi addresses Ibuki and Aoyama by name; さん dropped
